versions.changelog: Fix runtime namespace resolution so published skills load the correct project .image-skills config.
Stabilize project-scoped env loading and improve the article illustration workflow.
Align runtime config loading and safer image batch defaults.
Fix setup namespace defaults after install.

- Added comprehensive image generation references and configuration files under `scripts/vendor/shared-image-generation/references` (e.g., schema docs, presets, platform info).
- Introduced a new bundled set of scripts for setup, model recommendation, batch, and style menu functions within `scripts/vendor/shared-image-generation/scripts`.
- Expanded first-time setup and model registry documentation.
- Updated core metadata and package manifest to reflect new tooling.
- Minor edits and enhancements to documentation for clarity and completeness.

- Initial public release of rednote-images.
- Generate RedNote image series, including image cards, cover cards, and social infographic series with structured prompts and layout choices.
- Supports per-card workflow, stable outputs, and batch generation using WeryAI API.
- Requires WERYAI_API_KEY and Node.js/npm; includes step-by-step setup and quick verification.
- Reference images must be public URLs (HTTPS recommended); local paths are not supported.
- Includes tools for scaffolding projects, building prompts, and running image generation workflows.

RedNote image series generator initial release.

- Generate RedNote image cards, cover cards, and social infographic series with card-by-card prompts and bundled generation tooling.
- Supports structured selection of style and layout, mapped to the underlying image runtime.
- Requires public reference image URLs for series consistency (HTTPS recommended).
- Includes scripts to scaffold outlines, build prompts, and batch generate images via the WeryAI gateway API.
- Guides workflow from topic understanding to image batch creation and delivery.
- Outputs images and config to local `.image-skills/rednote-images/` folders; never runs arbitrary shell commands.

- Removed legacy shared-image-generation scripts and references for a leaner setup.
- Updated onboarding and environment variable guidance in docs.
- Minor fixes to application logic for key checks and error handling.
- Clarified use of IMAGE_GEN_API_KEY and improved related workflow notes.

- Major runtime directory refactor: replaced vendor/generation-runtime with vendor/shared-image-generation and new vendor submodules.
- Updated key scripts and workflows to use new vendor paths and shared-generation infrastructure.
- Added explicit environment requirements and clarified key handling in skill metadata.
- Updated commands: now use npm scripts (e.g., npm run generate) for image generation instead of direct runtime script calls.
- Removed old vendor directories; centralized and modularized vendor scripts and configs for easier maintenance and extension.

rednote-images v0.1.0 – Initial release  
- Generate RedNote image series, including cover cards and social infographic sequences, with structured style and layout options.
- Card-by-card workflow: scaffold outlines, specify prompts per card, and batch generate images.
- Supports reference images via public URLs for consistent multi-card series.
- Includes scripts for scaffolding, prompt generation, batch building, and image compression.
- Model selection and safe API key handling included, with default model and image runtime rules.
